part.description: Schweissplaettchen 1.75 Schwerlastkette / Welding plates 1.75 heavy load chain
part.geometry_master: DXF data - drawing note: manufactured according to DXF-data

notes: Verify mill certificate and heat number
Check flatness and absence of rust or scale before processing
Thickness 1.75 mm is the drawing baseline - separate revision required for 3 mm and 10 mm variants

holes.note: Hole position and diameter to be verified against DXF

unspecified_edges.meaning: No positive projecting burr permitted; edge break not to exceed 0.1 mm

face_control.symbol: flatness or parallelism - confirm with designer
face_control.note: ISO flatness normally does not reference a datum - confirm if flatness or parallelism to A

hole_feasibility_by_thickness.press_punching_feasible: Marginal - possible only with specialized micro-punching tooling; high punch-breakage risk
hole_feasibility_by_thickness.recommended_method: Wire EDM or specialized micro-punch in progressive die

hole_feasibility_by_thickness.press_punching_feasible: Not recommended - punch too slender, slug jamming, excessive taper
hole_feasibility_by_thickness.recommended_method: EDM start hole + Wire EDM to finished O1

hole_feasibility_by_thickness.press_punching_feasible: Not feasible - punch buckles and breaks
hole_feasibility_by_thickness.recommended_method: EDM start hole 0.3-0.5 mm + Wire EDM finish to O1

v1_75mm.production_route: Progressive press die for regular production; WEDM for samples or small batch

press_route.force_note: 40mm x 1.75mm x 350 N/mm2 = ~2.5T; with stripping and safety margin ~3.5-4T; 25T sufficient

progressive_die_stations.name: Hole piercing
operations: Pierce pilot holes in scrap carrier
progressive_die_stations.note: Pierce while material is full strip - do not blank first

progressive_die_stations.name: Profile trimming
progressive_die_stations.note: Retain component on strip via bottom edge or carrier tabs

progressive_die_stations.name: Flattening and cutoff
operations: Produce final bottom edge and 10.62 mm
progressive_die_stations.note: Restrike needed to achieve 0.05 mm face requirement

tooling.punch_guidance: Close-guided stripper plate, replaceable inserts, high-accuracy guide pillars
tooling.R01_corners: 0.10-0.15 mm WEDM wire with at least one skim cut; verify radius optically

strip_layout.note: Preliminary only - design from customer DXF

wedm_sample_route.applicable_for: Samples or small order where press tooling is uneconomical
steps: Cut S235 blanks with 3-5 mm stock around profile
Clamp in sandwich fixture between sacrificial plates
Drill 4 x O1 holes on Makino or ACE VMC from DXF coordinates
Stack-cut contour on Makino WEDM using 0.10-0.15 mm wire
Leave small retaining tabs during WEDM
Flatten between ground plates if required

drilling_parameters.note: Do not use radial or manual drill - runout and low RPM will break O1 drill

v3mm.production_route: Preliminary surface grinding - EDM start holes - WEDM O1 holes - WEDM profile with tabs - final surface grinding in skeleton - tab release - deburr - inspect
v3mm.press_punching: Not recommended - O1 ratio 0.33 too low

process_sequence.name: Material preparation
process_sequence.description: Cut S235 plate to nesting size e.g. 75x75 or 100x100 mm

process_sequence.name: Final surface grinding in skeleton
precautions: All parts on at least two tabs

revision_items: Redefine holes as through-holes 10 mm deep
v10mm.production_route: Band-saw blank - face mill if needed - surface grind to 10 mm - super-drill EDM start holes - WEDM O1 holes - WEDM profile with tabs - tab removal - deburr - inspect
v10mm.press_punching: Not feasible - O1 ratio 0.10; punch buckles, slugs jam

process_sequence.name: EDM starter holes
process_sequence.note: Drill all locations while in large plate

quantity_vs_process.process: Ground plate - EDM start holes - WEDM holes and profile
Multi-component WEDM nesting in one prepared plate
Larger nested plates, automated super-drilling and WEDM
Study fine-blanking for profile; secondary process still needed for O1 holes

machine_allocation.equipment: Perfect or HMT surface grinding machine
Makino WEDM, EDM, VMCs, surface grinders

machines_not_recommended.reason: O1 micro-punch needed; nibbling cannot hold 0.1 profile tolerance; R0.1 corners unreliable; tiny parts fall into machine
Spindle runout and low RPM will break O1 drills
Same issue as radial drill for O1 holes

shop_floor_process_1_75mm_press.name: Drawing and DXF review
shop_floor_process_1_75mm_press.notes: Confirm DXF revision, units, scale, burr side and datum A

shop_floor_process_1_75mm_press.name: Incoming material inspection
shop_floor_process_1_75mm_press.notes: S235 EN10025 certificate, thickness, flatness, rust and scale

shop_floor_process_1_75mm_press.name: Strip preparation
shop_floor_process_1_75mm_press.notes: Use slit strip or coil; do not manually cut each blank

shop_floor_process_1_75mm_press.name: Progressive tool setup
shop_floor_process_1_75mm_press.notes: Set shut height, feeder pitch, guides and lubrication

shop_floor_process_1_75mm_press.name: First-off piercing trial
shop_floor_process_1_75mm_press.notes: Inspect O1 holes, slug pulling, punch marks, distortion

shop_floor_process_1_75mm_press.name: Deburring
shop_floor_process_1_75mm_press.notes: Remove burr without rounding R0.1 corners

shop_floor_process_1_75mm_press.name: Final inspection
shop_floor_process_1_75mm_press.notes: Profile, hole size, position, burr and face condition

methods: Optical profile projector with DXF overlay
Vision measuring machine with DXF overlay
outer_profile.note: DXF is master geometry - do not reconstruct from PDF dimensions

holes.diameter_check: Calibrated pin gauges or optical measurement
additional_checks: Cracks in ligament near top edge

face_requirement.method: Place datum A on flat fixture; scan opposite face with 0.001 mm lever indicator
face_requirement.caution: Do not clamp heavily - hides distortion

thickness.method: Micrometer + surface plate and lever indicator

edges_and_burr.note: Keep burrs on one consistent face; confirm burr side with customer

drawing_clarifications.description: Drawing states manufactured per DXF. DXF must be obtained before tool design or CNC programming.
Hole is 0.57x material thickness at 1.75 mm. Tool life needs trials. At 3 mm and 10 mm conventional punching is not feasible.
~1 mm material between hole and top edge. Strong pressure pad required in die.
Symbol references datum A but ISO flatness normally does not reference a datum. Confirm flatness or parallelism to A.
Confirm which face carries the stamping burr. Cleaner face should be datum A.
Confirm if basic dimension with tolerance or nominal purchased sheet thickness.
Needed to decide between WEDM sample route and investment in progressive press tooling.
Both need formally revised drawing and DXF. Do not manufacture against 1.75 mm drawing.

summary_recommendations.1_75mm_samples: VMC drilling + fine-wire WEDM stack cutting
summary_recommendations.1_75mm_production: Three-station progressive die on Hensel 25T press
summary_recommendations.1_75mm_alternative: SNX 63T if 25T bed or shut height insufficient
summary_recommendations.3mm: Ground plate - EDM start holes - WEDM holes and profile - surface grind in skeleton - WEDM tab release
summary_recommendations.10mm: Band-saw blank - face mill/grind to 10 mm - super-drill EDM start holes - WEDM holes - WEDM profile - tab release
do_not: Punch O1 holes in 3 mm or 10 mm material
Use radial or manual drill for O1 holes
Use Amada turret punch as normal production process
Release any tool without the original DXF
Manufacture 3 mm or 10 mm variants against the 1.75 mm drawing
